items.item:
1. Kernel reading the projection of a project outside the set receives the
   not-found answer, identical to that of a random id.
   Shows A10-1, A10-2. [witness: verification:registry_a10_outside_set_answered_as_not_found]
statements: agent_call(session x) accepted, other than registering x =>   -- A10-1

token = Kernel and registered(x)
  and, for an operation on project p, p in granted(x)
answer(p not in granted(x)) = answer(p does not exist)   -- A10-2

quotes: assert sorted(f["kind"] for f in answer["failures"]) == sorted(kinds), answer
verdicts.why: The test confirms a registered Kernel session can read a granted project, while an unregistered session and a non-Kernel token are refused. It also asserts that an existing project outside the granted set receives exactly the same not-found refusal as a random nonexistent project ID, without leaking its alias.
